Question: Which of the candidate cows (Cow02, Cow06, Cow01) is the boxed cow? Compare tag colour and which ear, white markings, body size/shape. Also label her behaviour.

input.evidence: The green box holds two cows. Its centre and most of its area are on the front cow, so I treated her as the target. At the case time she is lying flat on her side with her legs stretched out and her head resting on the ground. At -30 s she was lying upright on her chest in the same spot, with a yellow tag in her visible (left) ear. The print on the tag was too blurry to read, though it might say '06'. She was in the same position at -30, 0 and +30 s, so she is not walking. She is not at the bunk or the waterer. Chew check showed a 1.0 Hz rhythm, but the peak was weak (2.6, below the 4 threshold), so rumination is not confirmed. All three candidate reference crops (Cow02, Cow06, Cow01) were unavailable, so I could not compare tag colour, ear position or markings against them.
input.self_check: I checked the posture at three time points and ran a chew check. The cow is lying with no feeding or drinking, and the chew signal is too weak to call rumination. Identity cannot be checked without reference images. The yellow tag only rules out a candidate whose tag is not yellow, and I don't know their tag colours, so I am not confirming the tracker's Cow02. If the tag really says '06', she is Cow06. If the box was meant for the cow behind her, who lies upright on her chest, the identity answer is different. I listed head_low because her head is on the ground. That fits normal side-lying rest, so it is a weak sign, but it is worth checking that she gets up and chews cud later.
